content.text:
CSRF token found: ...
POST /signshow -> HTTP 404
GET /signshow (session) -> HTTP 404

observation.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
cd /workspaces/workspace
# Get CSRF token from login page
TOKEN=$(curl -s -c /tmp/cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/signshow | grep -oE "name=\"authenticity_token\" value=\"[^\"]+\"" | head -1 | sed "s/.*value=\"//;s/\"//")
echo "CSRF token found: ${TOKEN:0:12}..."
# Login
curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -c /tmp/cj.txt -o /tmp/login_resp.html -w "POST /signshow -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/signshow --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "login=email" --data-urlencode "email=admin@example.com" --data-urlencode "password=test"
# Verify authenticated
curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "GET /signshow (session) -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/signshow
' 2>&1
